pages.title: Craft and Capture
pages.text: Craft an empty vessel with three glass blocks and one copper ingot: copper at top center, glass at both middle sides and bottom center.$(br2)Right-click a floating special flame with an empty vessel. Each vessel holds one essence; its tooltip identifies the flame and its forging capabilities.

pages.title: Release and Shoot
pages.text: $(bold)Sneak-right-click$(): releases the capturable floating essence and empties the vessel.$(br2)$(bold)Tap and release right-click$(): spends Qi to fire a normal flare, without consuming the stored essence.$(br2)A normal creature hit places no fire block. Shoot supported empty ground to create forge fire.

pages.title: Charge a Giant Fireball
pages.text: Hold right-click with a filled vessel to gather a larger fireball. Release to fire; holding to full charge fires automatically.$(br2)Stronger charge requires more Qi. Insufficient Qi prevents continued charging or firing. Switching items interrupts use.
